products.name: Noor-e-Zar Embroidered Lawn 3-Piece
products.shortDescription: Jet-black lawn with dense gold zari embroidery and a chiffon dupatta.
description: Noor-e-Zar pairs a deep black lawn shirt with intricate gold zari embroidery along the neckline, front panel and sleeves.
Completed with dyed trousers and a lightweight embroidered chiffon dupatta — an effortless choice for dawats and festive evenings.
